# Protocols are systems

> A protocol is a relation over roles, so a protocol is where a system's systemhood lives. Source: https://github.com/halcyonic-systems/protocols-are-systems

- [Blueprint](https://halcyonic.systems/protocols-are-systems/blueprint/): definitions, theorems, and open problems, each linked to its Lean declaration. LaTeX source in blueprint/src/content.tex.
- [Blueprint PDF](https://halcyonic.systems/protocols-are-systems/blueprint.pdf)
- [Dependency graph](https://halcyonic.systems/protocols-are-systems/blueprint/dep_graph_document.html)
- [Questions](https://halcyonic.systems/protocols-are-systems/questions/): questions from Protocol Symposium 2026 and SIGFPT, each with a one-line answer.
- [Talk](https://halcyonic.systems/protocols-are-systems/talk/): slides from the September 24, 2026 talk.
- [Lean sources](https://github.com/halcyonic-systems/protocols-are-systems/tree/main/Protocols)
